jobs.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and production sprite adaptation. EDIT/EXTRACTION TARGET is the approved five-panel orbital ring concept sheet. Match its SECOND slender, spacious design EXACTLY: inked hand-painted cream/teal/brass sci-fi industrial ring with fine open trusses, small orange cranes, restrained amber windows. NOT the earlier bulky fortress version. Extract only the specified ring system, REMOVE THE PLANET COMPLETELY and remove ALL navy backdrop, lettering and decorative separators. The entire interior and outside must be genuine alpha transparency, no dark disk, no stars, no ground or shadow, no painted checkerboard. Reconstruct only the short rear ring arc that was hidden by the planet. Do not redesign the ring. One complete isolated ring system on a SQUARE preferably 1536x1536 RGBA canvas. Center of its empty elliptical opening EXACTLY at canvas center; ellipse major axis horizontal, minor/major ratio 0.65. All ring structures and dock tips fully inside with generous 8% margin, no clipping. Very thin band like approved reference (3 to 4 percent of the former planet diameter), small local docks, no additional architecture filling gaps. The old planet would be a circle centered at the opening, but DO NOT DRAW IT. Extract TOP LEFT panel: broken small ring. One orbit of scattered disconnected slim old ring arc sections and a couple of broken small dock modules, large missing segments, dark inactive windows, patinated cream and teal armor. No complete ring and NO outer ring. Outline footprint has same elliptical proportions as the operational small ring. Entire broken-ring group centered.
